name: dense_q6k
title: Dense part Q8_0 -> Q6_K: a model file variant with about 23 % fewer dense bytes re-read every step

needs.model_file: models/qwen3.6-35b-a3b/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-IQ4_XS-mtp-q6dense-<variant>.gguf, made by tools/requant_dense.py (python3 tools/requant_dense.py SRC DST --groups attn,ssm,shexp | --groups all)

parity_check: Not identical by design (the weights are re-quantised): compare the perplexity of the source file and the variant with the llama.cpp perplexity tool on the same text, and the greedy answers of tools/quant_bench.py for drift.
notes: Expected speed gain is small (3 to 4 %). The engine takes Q6_K dense matrices on every path, but the Q8_0-only fast paths (the packed Q8_0 plane copy, the one-warp-per-row small-matrix kernel, the fused shared-expert gate and up kernel, the draft head subset kernel) are not used for them, so the gain can be lower or negative: compare the per-step GPU time. The file is about 0.4 GB smaller on the GPU. The 17 GB output file needs free disk space and a few minutes of single-core quantisation.
